claims.why_not_priced: No news search was run for this ticker (n_queries=0 in every admissible sweep) and the entire captured social stream is retail banter about the brand - not one message references a management change. A 19% drawdown with 'no bounce' and no stated cause, straddling a 5.02 filing, is a joined-up fact that no aggregator publishes. Direction is uncertain without the body, and I lean negative because departures get filed before results and because the successor's first commentary usually resets the guide.

claims.finding: Positioning into the print is extended and the sell-side is behind it: the stock is 269% above its 52-week low after a +47.44% reaction to the previous print, UBS's raised target of $95 (from $90, 2026-08-18) is only 12% above the pre-print price, another corpus item puts the 'latest analyst PT' at $80 - below the market - and participants describe high short interest and a squeeze dynamic rather than a fundamental bid.
claims.why_not_priced: Individually all wire copy; the combination is not, and it describes an equity trading above the sell-side's own marks on short-covering flow rather than on estimate revisions. A print that merely meets expectations removes the squeeze fuel. It cuts against itself to the extent a genuine short base can be squeezed further, which is why the band is wide.
